info.title: Ampio API
info.description: Move your app forward with the Ampio Smart Home API. This API provides endpoints to manage and control smart home devices, groups, and scenes.

get.summary: Function to control device (no value)
get.description: Control a device with a simple function that does not require a value. Example: `/api/set/1/turnOn`.

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: Function to perform on the device

get.summary: Function to control device with one value
get.description:
Control a device with a function that requires a single value. Example: `/api/set/1/setValue/200`.
List of functions:
- `setValue` (0-255)
- `setColor` (24-bit integer: `0xBBGGRR`)
- `setTemperature` (desired temperature, e.g., '21.5')
- `setVolume` (0-100 or 0-255, depending on device type)
- `setInput` (input index or name, e.g., '1', '40', 'line-in', 'hdmi1')
- `setSeek` (value 0-255)
- `setText` (string value)
- `setHeatingMode` (string: 'A' (Auto), 'S' (Standby), 'M' (Manual), 'H' (Holiday) for heating; or 'auto', 'cool', 'heat', 'fan' for AC)
- `setHeatingType` (0 for heating, 1 for cooling)
- `setMinTemperature` (desired temperature, e.g., '18.0')
- `setMaxTemperature` (desired temperature, e.g., '25.0')
- `setEcoTemperature` (desired temperature, e.g., '20.0')
- `setComfTemperature` (desired temperature, e.g., '22.5')
- `setWWColdness` (0-255)
- `setWWPower` (0-255)
- `setWW` (16-bit value: `0xCCPP` where CC=Coldness, PP=Power)
- `setBass` (0-255)
- `setMid` (0-255)
- `setTreble` (0-255)
- `setStation` (favorite station number)
- `setFreq` (frequency value)
- `removeStation` (favorite station number to remove)
- `setIpRadioPreset` (preset command, e.g., 'preset1')
- `setIpRadioButton` (command: 'resume', 'pause', 'next', 'prev', 'mute:1', 'mute:0', 'toggle')
- `setIpRadioUri` (URI/URL string)
- `setIpRadioSharelink` (URI/URL string)
- `setVerticalSwing` (swing value, e.g., 0-100)
- `setHorizontalSwing` (swing value, e.g., 0-100)
- `setFan` (string: 'A' (Auto), 'V' (Very Low), 'L' (Low), 'M' (Medium), 'H' (High), 'T' (Turbo))
- `setAc` (string: 'on' or 'off')
- `increment` (value to increment by, e.g., '10')
- `decrement` (value to decrement by, e.g., '10')
- `setFakeValue` (any value to set state )
- `setVirtualValue` (any value to set state)
- `setFakeParam2` (any value to set secondary state)
- `setValueDouble` (float/double value, e.g., '21.5')
- `setVirtualTemp` (float/double value, e.g., '22.3')
- `arm` (value is PIN)
- `disarm` (value is PIN)

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: Function to perform on the device

get.summary: Function to set RGB color with a white channel
get.description: Example: `/api/set/1/setColorW/65000/0`

get.summary: Function to set roller blind position and lammel
get.description: Example: `/api/set/5/setRollerPos/50/50`

parameters.name: lammel
parameters.description: Position of lammel (0-100). Pass 0 if not present.

get.summary: Function to set individual R, G, B, and W values
get.description: Example: `/api/set/1/setColors/0/0/0/0`

get.summary: Function to set Satel output with value and PIN
get.description: Controls a Satel output with a specified value and PIN.

get.summary: Function to change device PIN
get.description: Changes the PIN for a specific device.

get.summary: Function to set Warm White (WW) value with time
get.description: Sets the Warm White (WW) value for a device with a specified duration.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: WW value (power and coldness combined, e.g., 0xCCPP where CC is coldness and PP is power)

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time for which the value is to be set (x 10ms)

get.summary: Function to control device with value and time
get.description:
Example: `/api/set/1/setValue/1/100`.
List of functions:
- `setValue` (value 0-255, time x 10ms. e.g., 100 = 1 second)

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: Function to perform on the device

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time for which the value is to be set (x 10ms)

get.summary: Function to send notification for all users
get.description: The device endpoint allows sending a notification related to a specific device.

parameters.name: id_dev
parameters.description: ID of the device that is calling

get.summary: Function to send notification for all users
get.description: Sends a push notification to all users.

get.summary: Function to send notification for specified user
get.description: Sends a push notification to a specified user.

get.summary: Function sending event
get.description: Allows sending any event into the CAN network.

get.summary: Send text to LCD panel (upper field)
get.description: Sends text to the LCD panel's upper description field. Example: `/api/set/setLcdUp/Currency`

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Message to send to LCD panel

get.summary: Send digits to LCD panel (lower field)
get.description: Sends digits (and comma) to the LCD panel's lower value field. Example: `/api/set/setLcdDown/4,25`

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Message to send to LCD panel

get.summary: Set the water budget
get.description: Sets the water budget to a specified value (between 10 and 300).

get.summary: Function to return all scenes
get.description: The Scenes endpoint returns information about the Ampio Smart Home created scenes. The response includes the name and other details about scenes.

get.summary: Function to return all scenes
get.description: The Scenes endpoint returns information about the Ampio Smart Home created scenes. The response includes the name and other details about scenes.

get.summary: Function to run scene with provided id.
get.description: The function allows running the selected scene.

get.summary: Function to undo scene with provided id.
get.description: The function allows undoing the selected scene.

get.summary: Function to turn off scene with provided id.
get.description: The function allows turning off the selected scene.

post.summary: Add a list of pins or cards for a device
post.description: This endpoint allows you to add a list of pins or cards to a specific device in the Ampio Smart Home system.

post.summary: Save a list of pins or cards for a device
